{{Quote|When I was a Padawan, I did my own chores.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], expressing his unease with Anakin's droids|<ref name="AA" />}}
'''LE-4DO''' was an [[LE-series repair droid]] constructed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during his training at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. LE-4DO was built in memory of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], Anakin's droid on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and was programmed to assist the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] with his chores.<ref name="AA" /> The droid was cobbled together with parts scavenged from Coruscant's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]], and he was continually being adjusted and tweaked.<ref name="CSWE" /> LE-4DO wasn't very smart, but his usefulness led Anakin to create several more droids.
